daily.today_energy: Your vibe is grounded but curious today. There's a subtle shift asking you to trust your gut more and overthink less. The universe is rewarding authenticity—show up as yourself.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, small gestures speak louder than grand plans rn. Single? Someone's been noticing you from the sidelines. Either way, vulnerability is your superpower today.
daily.career: Your ideas are sharper than usual. This is a solid day to pitch that thought you've been sitting on or take a calculated risk. Your professional energy feels magnetic—lean into it.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance—maybe less caffeine, more water. Movement feels good today, whether that's a walk or stretching. Listen to what grounds you most.

weekly.overview: This week's energy feels like you're finally shedding a layer you've been holding onto. Mercury's vibe is pushing you toward authenticity—less performative, more real. Trust the quiet inner shifts happening beneath the surface.
weekly.love: Your people can feel when you're being more yourself, and honestly? It's magnetic. Whether you're single or coupled up, vulnerability is your secret weapon rn. Let someone see the softer side you usually keep locked away.
weekly.career: You're picking up on details others are missing—use that superpower. This isn't the week to play small or wait for permission. Your ideas have weight; the question is whether you're ready to claim that space.
weekly.health: Your body's asking you to slow down and actually listen to it. Movement that feels good (not punishing) and rest that actually restores you—that's the energy. Notice what genuinely serves you versus what you think you should do.
